baseline.method: Unchanged original BMVC2015 MGM8, complete author Adirondack Q acquisition

disparity_bad1_definition: Fraction of all finite independent measured disparities with absolute error greater than1 native pixel; occlusions are included.
geometry_definition: Maximum over every output pixel of abs(depth-f*B/(D+doffs))/(f*B/(D+doffs)); camera constants inREADME.
mask_provenance: Fixed independent structured-light measurement availability only; all354918 finite measurements, no reconstruction-based or nonocclusion-quality mask.
threshold_provenance: Independent original runs and bad controls before local extraction; criteria_frozen_before_local.json in private archive
